overall: No item has none or multiple correct choices under proximity agreement. The four choices within each item are meaningfully distinct. Across the set, C01/C02, C03/C04, C05/C07, and C06/C08 repeat the same two clauses in reverse order, reducing variety; mixed-number subjects and the repeated 'while' framing make the set somewhat artificial.
